document.about: Owens Corning ProCat blowing insulation data sheet, Spanish (2 pages). Its coverage tables give areas in square feet, PIES², with the 2 set small and raised after the unit.

notes: 2026-11-23 (#77): a raised number after a word of four letters or more was read as a note's, so every header with the unit read as footnote 2. A raised 2 or 3 after a unit of length is its power, kept raised.

checks.issue: The unit's power was parted from it as a note: BOLSAS POR CADA 1000 PIES 2.
As above, where nothing before the unit marks it as one: COBERTURA NETA MÁXIMA, PIES 2.
As above, after a slash and a space: PESO MÍNIMO/ PIES 2.
The power was read flat into its unit: LB/PIES2.
As above, everywhere the unit is used.
